summary: Tested backend admin/CMS endpoints (8/8 pytest passed) and frontend admin flow + Nabidka layout + public site reflection. Backend GET /api/content, POST /api/admin/login (200/401), and PUT /api/admin/content (with/without/wrong X-Admin-Password) all behave correctly. Persistence verified via Create→GET pattern. Frontend admin: login gate, wrong-password error toast (Nesprávné heslo), correct password (venku-admin-2026) opens editor with all 7 sections (nav, home, projects, services, about, vzdelavani, kontakt), edit→Save shows ✓ toast, edited eyebrow appears on public homepage in both CZ and EN. Nav is correctly hidden on /admin and present on public site. All public pages (/, /portfolio, /nabidka, /o-atelieru, /vzdelavani, /kontakt) load. Logout returns to login screen. Nabidka desktop layout: image is correctly the leftmost grid column, then number, content, detail (order correct). Mobile layout: image stacks at top correctly. ONE LAYOUT BUG: on desktop the process-img stays exactly at min-height 260px and does NOT stretch to full block height when the row is taller (item 01 row=357px / img=260px; items 02–04 row=309px / img=260px) — requirement was 'full block height'.

ui_bugs.issue: process-img does NOT stretch to full row height. With grid align-items:stretch and height:100% set, the image still measures exactly 260px (= min-height) even when the row is 309–357px. Likely cause: height:100% on a grid item with no sized track + aspect-ratio:auto resolves to content height (0), so only min-height applies. Fix options: (a) remove the explicit 'height: 100%' and rely on default align-self:stretch (current align-items:stretch on parent should be enough); (b) add 'align-self: stretch;' on .process-img; (c) raise min-height (e.g., 320–360px). User requirement was 'photograph on the left, full block height, no border'.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/App.css media query (>=700px) for .process-img, ensure the image fills the full row height. Recommended minimal change: drop 'height: 100%' and add 'align-self: stretch;' OR increase min-height to ~340px so img visually matches the tallest row.

Optional: also remove the bottom border on the process-item if 'no border' was intended for the photograph cell (currently borders are on .process-item top/bottom which is the row separator — confirm with user whether the border around the image cell is acceptable).
Optional clean-up: data/content.js still references PHOTOS.garden9 (undefined) — carried over from iteration_1; not retested but flagged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin endpoints are clean: ADMIN_PASSWORD read from env, _id and updated_at correctly excluded from GET /api/content response.

PUT /api/admin/content does a $set with the full payload — this is a full replace per top-level key, not deep-merge; if admin clears a section the data could be lost across mixed clients. ContentContext compensates with deep-merge against defaults, so this is acceptable for the simple-CMS scope but worth documenting.
Admin password is sent in plain JSON / header; acceptable per stated requirement (single pre-set password) but no rate limiting and no transport-only enforcement — mention to user.
Admin.jsx re-validates saved sessionStorage password on mount via POST /api/admin/login — good UX, no leak of password to localStorage.
Nabidka.jsx JSX order is image → num → content → detail (matches requirement). The grid CSS column order matches.
Mocked contact form (Kontakt) remains MOCKED via setTimeout — already known and called out by main agent.

rca of the issue: Bug: image not full block height. Reproduction: open /nabidka on viewport ≥1024px, inspect the 4 process items; .process-img boundingBox.height stays at 260 while the .process-item boundingBox.height is 309–357. RCA: in /app/frontend/src/App.css lines 1007-1013, .process-img sets height: 100% and min-height: 260px. Because .process-img is an empty <div> with background-image (no intrinsic content height), 'height: 100%' resolves against the grid track height, but in this layout the track is sized to the tallest content cell (.process-content) and the image's height: 100% appears to be ignored by the engine in favor of min-height (likely due to aspect-ratio:auto + percentage height interplay). Result: the image renders shorter than the row, leaving whitespace below it. Mitigation: remove 'height: 100%' and rely on default align-self: stretch from parent's align-items: stretch, OR explicitly add align-self: stretch on .process-img, OR raise min-height to match expected row height.
